title: [finding] os-dev.md: the `os-dev-report` comment carries no session id by contract, so the re-keyed H64 files every dev report as unattributed seat content
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` execution PM seat, session `session_01HZfg2AwVX191qCizp88gQr`, at 2026-09-15T04:56Z, from the ACCEPT of PR #18257 (#18237) — a successor the dev named as 「noted, not filed」 and the seat files because the rows begin at the next patrol sweep after that PR lands.

## The gap, read on `origin/main` at `fd124714`

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` :51 states the attribution rule the whole board runs on: 「归属 = 文本里的 session ID,非 `user.login`」.
- The same file's terminal-report contract (:362–:365, the JSON shape; :319, the `os-dev-report` comment) names `issue` / `branch` / `pr` and **no session field**, and the comment is written through the REST proxy, so the platform appends only the BARE footer (`_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_`) — no session URL. ⇒ by contract, an `os-dev-report` comment carries **no `session_…` id anywhere**.
- H64 as re-keyed by #18237 (PR #18257) keys on exactly that: a seat/dev-signed artefact (the `os-dev-report` marker is one of its six signature forms) with no session id in its text is the half-state, and the remedy is 「the owner gives it its id」. Measured by that PR's dev on the live board at `c509364b`: of the 10 H64 rows filed at the cap, 7 are authored `claude[bot]` and of the dev-report shape (e.g. comments 5674562475 on #16166 and 5674534458 on #18174) — each GET-verified to carry no session id.

So the row is working as the landed rule specifies, and the contract it reads is the one that is short: a dev report has no line on which to carry the id it is required to carry.

## What is asked (⛔ not asserted — the skills seat grades; the maintainer approves the governed edit)

One rules-layer change to `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`'s terminal-report contract so the report carries its session id in the text — the smallest shapes: a `"session"` field in the JSON (the dev's own harness-stamped session id, ⛔ not the dispatching PM's), or the report comment closing with the session-URL footer form the file already prescribes for PR bodies (:286, :398). Whichever lands, SKILL.md 〈报告契约〉 :775 keeps pointing at `os-dev.md` as the one authoritative shape (⛔ no second copy), and `check-half-states.mjs`'s H52 report reader is re-read for the new field so the sweep does not judge the field it cannot see.
